name: textedit-fallback-edit-cap
title: Cap text-edit fallback streaming edits when CardKit create fails
description: When Lark CardKit card-create fails mid-turn and the reply streams via the text-edit fallback, cap interim edits (freeze after N, deliver complete text on the final flush) so long replies are not truncated. The fallback currently inherits CardKit's unbounded interim cadence.
creator: eanzhao
